field.label: SOCKS5 Listen Address
field.help: IP address xray-core binds for its SOCKS5 inbound. hev-socks5-tunnel connects here to forward all TUN traffic through the proxy. Use 127.0.0.1 (loopback, recommended), 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces), or any IP assigned to a real OPNsense interface (e.g. 192.168.1.1). Other 127.x.x.x addresses require a manual lo0 alias on FreeBSD and are not recommended.

field.label: SOCKS5 Port
field.help: Local loopback port xray-core binds for SOCKS5 inbound
field.hint: Default: 10808. hev-socks5-tunnel connects here to forward TUN traffic. Must not be used by another process.

field.label: TUN Interface
field.help: Virtual network interface created by hev-socks5-tunnel
field.hint: Default: proxyhev2socks0. Must match the name in Interfaces → Assignments.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit for the TUN interface
field.hint: Default: 1500. Reduce to 1380 if large packets (e.g. SSH, large downloads) fail or are slow.

field.label: Health check HTTPS URL
field.help: Must be reachable through every proxy. Used by Xray Observatory and Test Connection.

field.label: Probe interval (seconds)
field.help: Pool probes run in the background; switching waits for failed probes to finish.

field.label: Xray Log Level
field.hint: warning is recommended for production. Use debug only for troubleshooting — it generates a lot of output.
